# Math Fact Fluency Interview Sheet

Subject: Intervention
Grade band: 3-5
Resource type: Interview Sheet
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation Mathematics Learning Standards

## Short Description
A short interview sheet for uncovering student strategies behind fact fluency responses.

## Alignment Note
Supports intervention planning by distinguishing recall, counting, derived facts, and misconceptions.

## Classroom Use Case
Use with three students during independent work to plan targeted small groups.

## Preview Content
- Problem solved
- Student strategy said aloud
- Next strategy to teach

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
